Planner settings
Radio and channel
Propagation
R0.01 is read from the ITU-R P.837-7 digital map (0.125° grid, bilinear) at each AP's coordinates and applied to that AP's links. You can override it per AP in the AP card.
Rain: ITU-R P.837-7 map or P.837 zone rate, P.838-3 specific attenuation, P.530-17 path reduction and percentage scaling. Gases: P.676 Annex 2.
Terminal units (TU)
New TUs get the default antenna. You can change it per TU from its popup. Dish gain and beamwidth follow the frequency and dish efficiency (same formula as the link calculator).
Interference
Antenna model: 3GPP TR 38.901 horizontal pattern, G(φ) = Gmax − min(12·(φ/φ3dB)², F/B). AP φ3dB = sector beamwidth; TU φ3dB = 30° or 45° for patch arrays, ≈ 70·λ/D for dishes. All co-channel sectors are assumed to transmit downlink at the same time (synchronised TDD), interferer paths are assumed LoS, adjacent-channel leakage is ignored. Interference from other sectors of the serving AP always gets the same rain fade as the wanted signal (same path).
Terrain and line of sight
No terrain tiles downloaded yet.
No local tiles loaded: using online APIs.
Elevation data is a bare-earth model (SRTM / Copernicus). Terrain tiles download automatically when you place an AP; the rate-limited point APIs are only a fallback. Buildings and trees are not in it, so set a clutter height for urban areas. Paths with missing elevation data are flagged “LoS unverified”, not treated as clear.

Capabilities and throughput
Tables and chart
Chart range is automatic when empty: 10 km with a dish at either end, 2 km otherwise.

Half-peak range at 99.9% availability

–

Definition: the longest distance at which the link, at 99.9% availability, still delivers at least half of its peak capacity. Peak capacity = PHY rate at the max MCS × streams × MAC efficiency, at the same bandwidth and guard interval.

Maximum distance (km)

User capacity per MCS and bandwidth (Mbps)

PHY model mirrors wifi7Radio: rate = tones × bits × coding rate / (12.8 µs + GI); threshold RSL = −114 + 10·log10(BW) + NF + SNR(MCS). A link closes at an MCS when RSL − threshold ≥ margin. Path loss = FSPL + gaseous (P.676) + rain at the chosen availability (P.838-3 / P.530-17), valid for 0.001–1 % outage.
